text:
alex: seeing TTFT and tokens/sec go negative and large gaps in Console after a consumer rebalance around 2026-03-15 12:17 UTC. cc @maria
metrics-alert-bot: [alert] streaming-ttft: negative delta detected for tenant acct_123 - several windows flagged
maria: can you paste the query you're using for the dashboard? also which route/cluster?
alex: route=hosted-us-west, dashboard query:
```
SELECT window_start, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(duration_ms) as duration_ms,
  (CASE WHEN duration_ms>0 THEN tokens*1000/duration_ms ELSE NULL END) as tok_per_sec
FROM streaming_rollups
WHERE tenant_id='acct_123' AND window_start >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start
```
we see many windows NULL or negative tok_per_sec, with neighbouring windows normal.
raj: did we recently rebalance the ingest consumers? I see a consumer group rebalance at ~12:17 in the broker logs.
kevin: possible cause: out-of-order offsets or a brief rewind; our rollup calculates delta = curr_count - prev_count, so if prev > curr you get negative deltas.
alex: here's a small snippet from rollup_worker logs around the incident:
```
[2026-03-15T12:17:12Z] rollup_worker tenant=acct_123 window=2026-03-15T12:17:00Z processed_count=0 delta=-42
[2026-03-15T12:18:12Z] rollup_worker tenant=acct_123 window=2026-03-15T12:18:00Z processed_count=120 delta=120
```
maria: ack. can you run `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-us:9092 --describe --group rollups-tenant-123` and paste the offsets?
alex: ran it, pasted below:
```
TOPIC               PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
ingest-tenant-123   3          10450           10450           0
ingest-tenant-123   4          15333           15334           1
```
support-bot: ticket #INC-9342 created and triaged to eng-runtime with priority P2
raj: looks consistent with a brief partition transition on partition 4; if a producer rewound or we reprocessed duplicates the stored prev_count index can be higher than the new current. Our rollup assumes monotonic counters.
kevin: short-term mitigation: clamp negative deltas in the aggregation layer, e.g. `GREATEST(curr-prev, 0)` or ignore delta < 0 rows when computing tok/sec. That will prevent negative tokens/sec from reaching Console.
maria: agreed. for prod we'll patch the rollup to be idempotent and tolerant to out-of-order offsets (treat negative delta as 0 and emit a metric). I'll open a PR and schedule a backfill.
alex: can we run a backfill for the affected 12:00-13:00 window now? ETA?
raj: `scripts/rollup_backfill --tenant acct_123 --start 2026-03-15T12:00 --end 2026-03-15T13:00` should run. On staging that's ~6-10m, on prod for this tenant ~30-40m due to shard size.
kevin: also adding monitoring: emit an alert when negative delta count > 1 per minute per tenant, and add a dashboard panel to show raw prev/curr counts so we can triage quicker.
alex: I'll send a quick customer-facing note: "We observed transient ingestion rebalances that produced negative deltas in rollups; we've clamped UI values and are running a backfill. Full fix will be in next deploy." :thumbsup:
maria: on it, will attach PR and link to backfill job in the ticket. :eyes:
kevin: after backfill completes we should verify Console windows for 12:00-13:00 are restored and alert suppression lifted.
alex: thanks everyone — assigning to @maria and @raj for rollout + postmortem.
